lines.text: Hi, we are Sytronsoft. Last time: the cameras ZoneGuard A I works with. Today: one desk, two people. Who notices?
ZoneGuard A I monitors workstation presence in real time. One desk, one person. All calm.
One person works at the desk. Then someone else walks in, and stops at the same workstation.
ZoneGuard A I notices: more than one person is detected.
So ZoneGuard A I raises an alert, and that alert comes with its own snapshot.
The operator gets the alert, and its snapshot sits right there, inside the same alert card.
Then the operator presses Acknowledge. Operators acknowledge alerts, for a clear audit trail.
Video and records stay on your device. One hundred percent on-premise.
Visit sytronsoft dot com, info at sytronsoft dot com, Electronic City, Bengaluru.
